description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the variable N and AUC percentage, comparing multiple lines representing different data sets or models. The x-axis is labeled 'N', has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 15, and has tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled 'AUC (%)', also has a linear scale, ranges from 75 to 100, and has tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot contains five lines: a blue line with circle markers, solid style, starting at around 95% at N=0.7 and increasing to approximately 103.5% at N=17; an orange line with diamond markers, solid style, beginning at around 85% at N=0.7, rising to about 103.5% at N=7, then slightly decreasing to around 102.5% at N=12 before increasing again to approximately 104% at N=17; a green line with star markers, solid style, starting at roughly 87% at N=0.7, steadily increasing to about 100% at N=12, and reaching around 102.5% at N=17; a red line with square markers, solid style, beginning at approximately 88% at N=0.7, rising to around 102% at N=7, then decreasing to about 98% at N=12 before slightly increasing to approximately 99% at N=17; and a purple line with triangle markers, solid style, starting at around 80% at N=0.7, remaining relatively stable until N=5, then sharply increasing to about 102% at N=7, followed by a decline to roughly 94% at N=12, and stabilizing at around 94% at N=17.
